def is_nested(s):
    # A valid subsequence must contain at least one nested pair: [ ... [ ... ] ... ]
    # We track the maximum depth of '[' seen so far.
    depth = 0
    max_depth = 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '[':
            depth += 1
            if depth > max_depth:
                max_depth = depth
        elif ch == ']':
            depth -= 1
    # Need at least one position where depth reaches 2 (i.e., a '[' inside another '[')
    # and the overall string must be a valid bracket sequence (balanced, never negative).
    # Re-check validity properly.
    depth = 0
    nested = False
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '[':
            depth += 1
            if depth >= 2:
                nested = True
        elif ch == ']':
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
    return depth == 0 and nested

# Tests
print(is_nested('[[]]'))      # True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))  # False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # False
